corrections.name: REPRESENTATION_BLOWUP_GUARD
corrections.reason: Run1 found representation blow-up historical and cross-branch recurring, but not explicit in v1 factoring restoration.
corrections.law: A small hash/reference count cannot hide a large unique payload, serialization volume or lookup cost.

corrections.name: MESSAGE_LANGUAGE_AWARE_INTERFACE_PROFILE
corrections.reason: Run1 strongest cross-era edge EXACT_FULL_TYPED_STATE <-> INTERFACE_BOUNDARY_WIDTH had 214 supporting sources.
corrections.law: Interface measurements are indexed by exact message language; node count alone has no theorem authority.

corrections.name: BOUNDARY_GATED_COMPOSITION

corrections.law: Two certificate languages compose only through an exact shared-boundary projection/consistency certificate. Independent parallel solvers are not composition.

corrections.name: OPEN_LIFECYCLE_EXPANSION
